name: sdd-synthesis-port
description: Port the deterministic pieces of the SteelForge SDD synthesis (SDD-PARA-OPENSDD.md) that open-sdd does not already own: an EARS→Gherkin acceptance generator and task-grammar checks inside the cross-artifact consistency report. Everything the guide proposes that open-sdd already implements, or that would fork an existing vocabulary, is declared out of scope with the owning module.
